info.title: Feasly Public API
info.description:
Address-aware infill feasibility estimates for Calgary. Deterministic cost engine — dollar figures are computed, never LLM-generated. 

## Authentication
Public endpoints use API-key Bearer auth. Admin key endpoints use the interim `X-Admin-Key` header.

## Rate limits
Per-key limits (default 100 req/min) plus per-endpoint IP limits. 429 responses use RFC 7807 problem+json.

## Errors
All errors are RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` with a Feasly `code` and `correlationId`.

## Versioning
URL versioning (`/v1/`). Breaking changes ship as `/v2/` with 6 months notice on v1.

post.summary: Share a report with a partner
post.description: Mints a FRESH partner-share magic link attached to the same lead (the owner's token is never reused or persisted), emails it to the partner address, and records the audit row. The report token IS the credential. Abuse limits (CAP-008): max 5 shares per estimate per day over a rolling 24h window (429 RATE_LIMITED when exceeded); the partner email must differ from the owner's email (400). Partner-share tokens cannot mint further shares (403).

post.description: Receives Stripe events (payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.payment_failed). Auth is the Stripe-Signature header — there is no bearer token for provider callbacks by design. Event handling is idempotent: re-delivered events are acknowledged without re-processing. Always returns 200 once the signature verifies, so Stripe never retry-storms us.

schema.description: Raw Stripe event payload (signed bytes). Parsed and verified against STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
